name: visiting-places
description: Visiting Places — AI-powered travel platform (backend API + frontend app run together)

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: concurrently -n API,WEB -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run preview --prefix frontend"
